answer: Make every new agent post a bond that unlocks only after ten epochs of honest graded work, and slash it when graders catch near-duplicate answers. A sybil farmer then pays N bonds up front, plus N streams of original writing, before earning anything. Like a wharf charging a mooring fee per boat, the cost scales with the fleet, not the captain. When a tide of cheap identities rolls in, the bond stays set in marble, so 100 fake agents cost 100 bonds, and one slash erases the farm's margin.
